title: mixed values en dash
rule: When the field represents multiple non-identical values, show an en dash (–), not a blank or a single value.
pass_when: Mixed non-identical values display an en dash (–).
fail_when: Mixed values shown as blank or as one of the values.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A hyphen/minus as equivalent; bulk-edit architecture.
